method_source.paper: Merlin: A Vision Language Foundation Model for 3D Computed Tomography
method_source.method: Multiple finding-present and finding-absent phrases are embedded and compared with the CT image embedding using mean cosine similarity.

prompt_provenance.selection: Fixed before held-out evaluation; not selected with development or held-out labels.
prompt_provenance.note: The Merlin publication and repository do not release a prompt bank for these five dataset classes. These prompts adapt the publication method to this task.

class_assumptions.Cholezystitis: Dataset spelling retained for outputs; prompts use the clinical English spelling cholecystitis.
class_assumptions.Perforation: Interpreted as gastrointestinal or hollow-viscus perforation.

class_semantics_status: Implementation assumptions approved for this run design but not independently verified from dataset provenance; treat results as exploratory until confirmed.
